MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #13
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 9 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 3
   C. 15
   D. 21

2. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 13
   C. 36
   D. 5

3. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 11
   C. 22
   D. 121

4. In the number 3545, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

5. Solve for x: x + 8 = 18. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 8
   C. 10
   D. 18

6. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

7. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 100 000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 1000 m²
   D. 100 m²

8. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 21
   C. 1
   D. 20

9. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 170
   D. 169

10. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 7

11. In the number 3145, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 90
   C. 18
   D. 81

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

1. C — 15
Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 9² + 12²
3. c² = 81 + 144
4. c² = 225
5. c = 15
Final Answer: 15 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse

2. C — 36
Working:
